gate_2_walls_by_the_grid.claim: the walls carried by the grid reproduce the corrected band (the window spike's question 7: K over the free sphere's against dev1's tube table at the true position, both over the free sphere's) at a/R 0.1 to 0.34 from about one cell of gap to the axis, within 2 pp + 0.1 |e_band|, both dtypes

prediction.unit: the pose's error less the band's, percentage points (radial and axial)
prediction.basis: measured-before at (0.2, 2 cells): +0.23 radial, +0.15 axial at seed 0's lattice draw, +0.89 and +0.82 with the tube's axis on a lattice node: the lattice alignment moves it by about 0.7 pp there (the band's own control moved 0.35 pp for R2's offset); MIME's band carries an interior ramp the spike's did not (row #315), so its wall may sit a few hundredths of a cell from the spike's, about 0.8 pp a tenth of a cell at 2 cells (the error's slope there); the a/R 0.34 row is an extrapolation of the band, so its poses may sit nearer the line; float32 within 0.2 pp of float64
prediction.why: the coupling is the spike's own (the 338-point sphere, the projected CG, the kernel, the free box with Hasimoto's term, the flux-free tube): the same numbers to the grid's wall placement and the lattice

gate_2_walls_by_the_grid.metric: per pose: 100 (K/K_table - 1) radial and axial; GMRES products; at_cap

control.plant: offset: the reference read 0.37 of a cell farther from the wall (R2's own error); image: the near field's matrix plus the tube's image at its force points (the walls counted twice)
control.expected_rate: offset 3/3 at (0.2, 2 cells): the table's slope there moves the read by about 8 pp (R2 read about half the true error below 5 cells), three to four times the line; image 3/3: seen once locally (seed 0) radial -169 %, axial +659 % with 9 products and no cap: the tube's point-read image 2 cells from the wall makes the near field's matrix ill-posed rather than adding the walls' share once more (the +15 to +60 % first expected, before that run, was wrong), so it is caught by far
control.resolution: the offset's shift falls under the line beyond about 6 cells (the band's slope there), so it is run at 2 cells

gate_2_walls_by_the_grid.if_wrong: a pose past the line by more than its lattice spread: a wall placed other than the band's (the band's interior ramp, its effective radius), the free box's images or the flux removal; float32 past 0.2 pp of float64: its CG's floor in the steady limit
gate_2_walls_by_the_grid.cannot_discriminate_if: the offset plant at gaps of 8 cells or more

gate_4_contact_one_pass.claim: a body in contact folds the handed response into its own step (RigidInertialNode.stepped and held, the confinement held inside its solve): the composed field, tractions and twist equal the monolithic step with the active contact row held as an equality

prediction.unit: relative miss of field, tractions and twist
prediction.basis: measured-before (seed 0: 7.7e-13, 3.2e-11, 1.3e-12) and gate 3's at the same tolerances; the tractions' miss the largest, the near-contact columns' conditioning
prediction.why: the contact row is linear in the twist and the handed response is the whole step's Schur complement onto the twist

gate_4_contact_one_pass.metric: the misses; the normal velocity held; the contact active in both (outward before held, multiplier positive)

control.plant: the handed response replaced by its diagonal blocks (translation and rotation decoupled)
control.expected_rate: 5/5: the twist misses by about 1e-4 to 1e-3 (seen 4.2e-4), three decades past the line
control.resolution: the coupling of translation and rotation a quarter of a cell from the wall

gate_4_contact_one_pass.if_wrong: a miss past the line with the contact active: the node's solve system other than M/dt + R, or the multiplier along another normal; a draw where the contact is not active fails on its premise, not on the law

gate_7_poiseuille_read.claim: the read of a provided flow: an MRS sphere held, then free, in the tube's Poiseuille flow on the FVM, against Haberman and Sayre on the axis (a/R 0.1 to 0.3) and free-space Faxén off it (a/R 0.1, b/R 0.4)

prediction.basis: measured-before (a/R 0.2: held -1.37, free -0.84; Faxén -0.90) and derived: the kernel's read 2 h^2/(R^2 - b^2) low (0.78 % on the axis, measured), the free speed's miss; the held force adds the grid's floor on the axis (the walls' band: -0.4 to -1.9 % from a/R 0.1 to 0.3, MIME's a little smaller); Haberman and Sayre's reflections accurate to about 0.1 % at these a/R [recalled]
prediction.why: the near field reads the base field through the exchange kernel's average; the walls are the grid's

gate_7_poiseuille_read.metric: held F/(R_free V)/K_HS - 1; free U/V over Haberman and Sayre's - 1; Faxén U over V(1 - b^2/R^2 - 2/3 lambda^2) - 1; the across-flow speed

control.plant: the read removed: the base a medium at rest's zero
control.expected_rate: 3/3: the held force and the free speed zero, -100 %

gate_7_poiseuille_read.if_wrong: held past 3 % or free past 1.5 %: a read other than the kernel's average (the base gathered at the wrong points or the box's carried field read into the load), or the recalled formula; a free speed across the flow: a reflection not reciprocal
gate_7_poiseuille_read.cannot_discriminate_if: never: the plant removes the whole read

gate_10_helix_far_field.claim: a rotating helix's scattered MRS distribution carries its far field (the torque's rotlet and the stresslet) through a large free box: the plane medians within 3 % from 0.75 to 2 D, the axis at 2 D within 5 %

prediction.basis: measured-before (2.04, 1.53, 0.81, 1.00 %; axis 3.73 %); R5 measured 0.9, 0.6, 0.6, 0.5 % for a line of Stokeslets at the same box: the MRS surface distribution and MIME's kernel read about twice that near the helix, where the kernel's average of a field curving over 4 to 5 cells is the term (the gate 7 mechanism, here (h/r)^2 at r about 0.6 D)
prediction.why: the scattered distribution keeps every moment; the box's images of the torque and stresslet are small at 16 D

gate_10_helix_far_field.metric: the medians over twelve plane points per distance and the axis's two points

control.plant: the net force alone scattered at the centre
control.expected_rate: 3/3: the net lateral force's Stokeslet is about 3 % of the rotlet at 1 D, so the miss is about the whole field (over 90 %)

gate_10_helix_far_field.if_wrong: a median past the line: the kernel's or the box's images, or the helix's sub-cell place (drawn)
